risks.risk: Disc playing surface may be scratched or damaged, affecting whether it reads/plays at all.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the disc's non-label (data) side under good light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / heavily scratched

risks.risk: Case may be missing the manual/inlay or have a cracked hinge/clips, lowering resale value.
risks.proof: Photo of the closed case front, back, and spine, plus inside tray.

risks.risk: The photo appears to carry a third-party watermark ('TED QUALITY', 'GOJSA GROUP'), suggesting it may be a reused/stock image rather than the seller's actual item in hand.
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the actual disc and case taken by the seller, ideally with a handwritten note or timestamp, or a video showing the disc being removed from the case.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified stock, risk of item not matching photo

risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified authenticity, worst case treated as non-genuine

proof_requests: A fresh, seller-taken photo of the disc's playing (data) surface in good light.
Photos of the case front, back, spine, and inside tray to confirm completeness and condition.
A photo or short video of the disc being inserted/read on a console to demonstrate it works.
If PS5 titles are also offered, individual photos of each disc and case.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used PS4 disc copy of Watch Dogs Legion, but condition, playability, and authenticity are unverified, and the photo itself shows signs of being a possibly reused/stock image, so it must be priced at worst case pending further proof.
